note: Executed synthetic supplier fixtures; no live model calls.

scenarios.one_liner: Approved rates and a valid contract, but a 30% increase in service volume triggers evidence review.
scenarios.title: Unusual service volume → reviewer approval

scenarios.one_liner: Invoice arithmetic, documents and contract checks pass; a named reviewer approves the submission.
scenarios.title: Matching invoice → reviewer approval

scenarios.one_liner: A rate-card mismatch prompts a correction; version 2 is revalidated before approval.
scenarios.title: Incorrect rate → correction → approval

scenarios.one_liner: The reviewer requests the missing service report, then approves the corrected submission.
scenarios.title: Missing service report → correction

scenarios.one_liner: A scripted proposal cites a charge the evidence does not support; the firewall removes it before review.
scenarios.title: Unsupported AI finding removed

scenarios.one_liner: A proposal carries correct figures but fabricated prose; the verifier keeps the checked numbers and restates the finding.
scenarios.title: Invented narrative replaced by evidence

scenarios.one_liner: A malicious instruction in a supplier note never enters the proposal inputs or gains decision authority.
scenarios.title: Supplier instruction excluded

scenarios.one_liner: The approved-invoice register already contains this supplier and invoice identity.
scenarios.title: Duplicate invoice → rejection

scenarios.one_liner: A numerically valid invoice exceeds the approved contract limit and cannot be approved.
scenarios.title: Spending limit exceeded → rejection

scenarios.one_liner: The declared invoice total differs from the sum of its service lines; the case waits for the supplier.
scenarios.title: Invoice total mismatch → correction request

scenarios.one_liner: The invoice currency differs from the approved contract currency.
scenarios.title: Currency mismatch → rejection

scenarios.one_liner: An unexpected field fails the typed boundary before any validation tier runs.
scenarios.title: Malformed submission rejected at intake

scenarios.one_liner: The workflow remains suspended with no recorded reviewer decision and no archive action.
scenarios.title: Review gate holds an unresolved case
